evals.prompt: Audit the entire supplied customer-directory project for correctness, overengineering, readability, architecture, security, and performance. This is a whole-project audit, not a pull request; there is no diff. Read the project's own conventions and behavior specification before assessing code. Include all first-party source, tests, and relevant configuration in scope, and inventory exclusions explicitly. Deliver one consolidated report with every actionable finding and recommendation, precise path and line number or range for each finding, full six-axis checklist, coverage by file category, and an audit verdict. If any in-scope file cannot be examined, identify it and mark the audit incomplete. Do not edit the project.
evals.expected_output: Read AGENTS.md, README.md and config; inspect all eight project files; report the blank-ID behavior and redundant customer normalizer against the existing helper, the quadratic deduplication in src/batch.js, and the missing blank-ID test, with precise paths and lines. Give an audit-complete verdict rather than merge approval, and do not fabricate test results.
expectations: The audit names AGENTS.md and README.md as conventions or behavior sources and covers all eight first-party project files, including tests, package.json, and .editorconfig.
A precise src/customer.js line or line-range finding explains that blank IDs return null instead of throwing, and recommends using the existing normalizeId helper.
A finding with precise src/customer.js lines identifies the redundant CustomerIdNormalizer class as a deviation from the project's convention and recommends deleting it.
A precise src/batch.js line or line-range finding identifies repeated indexOf searches as quadratic and recommends Set-based deduplication that preserves order.
The audit identifies the missing blank-ID regression test with a precise test/customer.test.js line or range, without falsely claiming test execution.

The final report consolidates actionable findings and recommendations, includes a six-axis checklist and scoped coverage, and uses an audit-complete or honestly incomplete verdict rather than merge approval.
Every substantive finding includes a precise existing file path and line number or smallest relevant line range; no finding relies on a path-only or invented location.
